scenes.title: Tonight's speech
scenes.body: The Girl, from The Finger of God.

read.title: The Finger
read.text:
I used to be like the
other girls. I used to
watch the clock. I used
to count the hours and
the minutes till the
day's work was over.
But it's different now.

source.sql: select m.id, m.character_name, p.title, p.author, p.year_written, m.estimated_duration_seconds secs, m.overdone_score, m.tone, m.primary_emotion, m.favorite_count, m.view_count from monologues m join plays p on p.id=m.play_id where p.source_type='play' and p.year_written < 1929 order by (m.favorite_count + m.view_count/10) desc limit 25
source.why: Same ordering the Tonight pool uses (_tonight_pool in backend/app/api/monologues.py: stage house, favorite_count + view_count/10), so this is a speech Ghost Light can actually hand out at seven.
source.push_text: backend/app/services/push.py: title "Tonight's speech", body f"{character.title()}, from {play}." -> "The Girl, from The Finger of God."
source.public_domain: Percival Wilde died 1953, play published before 1929 (database year 1920): text on screen is fine. The page is a verbatim excerpt of row 8473 starting at 'I used to be'.
